tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: Search shops that publish a signed Agent Card, plus shops listed from public data (provenance "unclaimed": search-only, no door). Shops are listed by how well their PRODUCTS match, best first; demo stores, wholesalers, off-topic sellers and non-shop sites (reviews, how-to, repair, coupons, with no k

tools.name: catalog.lookup
tools.description: Return the catalog record of one indexed shop, from its origin (https://shop.example) or from any page URL on it, such as a product link. The record is the same JSON as GET /catalog/shop?origin=<origin>: name, provenance, DID and Agent Card URL when signed or claimed, and when the catalog last read

tools.name: catalog.get_product
tools.description: Return one stored product of one indexed shop, chosen by the shop's origin (https://shop.example, or any page URL on it) and the product's permalink, or its sku where the catalog shows one. The answer is the same JSON as that product's entry in GET /catalog/shop/products.json?origin=<origin>: name,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: catalog.search, catalog.lookup, catalog.get_product · Private data: catalog.lookup · Public sink: catalog.search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: catalog.search, catalog.lookup, catalog.get_product · Private data: catalog.lookup · Public sink: catalog.search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
